newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka finishes firmer against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka finishes firmer against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka lost its clear early edge to close slightly firmer at 42.3725/42.3925 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous 42.3750/42.3950, dealers said.
The taka quoted at 42.3600/42.3900 in early trading against the dollar but dealers said it remained strong despite moderate demand for dollars. There was also an inflow of dollars.
Dealers said trade volume was around $15 million.
The interbank call money rates closed unchanged at 4.0 percent to 4.5 percent, they said.
